results.name: A full pod fires a burst of four, never closer than the gap, then a tap on the empty pod is dropped and says so
An empty slot regrows in six times the wave reload, one at a time (levels and endless)
A seed that touches a flower gives back half a seed; a miss gives nothing
A crown feeds the pod for itself and each flower it opens; a crack counts; a cup or shell deflection does not
A full pod takes nothing more, and a strike no seed earned (a test, the script) feeds nothing
A tap a blink early is kept and fires the moment the seed is ready, with the latest aim
Five seeds in the air still refuse a tap without keeping it or calling the pod dry
Super Bloom fires from the sun: no seeds spent, a seed every .22 s, no feeding, and the pod keeps regrowing
A Dandelion fans three seeds for one pod seed
The tutorial: setting the cooldown to zero hands over a full pod, early taps are simply dropped, the script earns nothing
The snapshot and the launch event carry the pod
Mashing with no aim loses: nearly every level from 2 on, early, and costs lives on level 1
Rough aim at full speed does clearly worse than aiming: lives on levels 2-3, and it loses level 4 and the hard deep levels
A fast, careful aimer clears every level, firing briskly
The suite runs in 30 seconds or less
